comparison.objective: Locate a DC earth fault by sectionalizing fuse circuits one at a time.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeatedly extract and reinsert fuse carriers while reading a meter and preserving circuit availability.
comparison.success_condition: Only the faulty F3 feeder remains open, with no episode of two circuits open together; the record supplies geometric carrier criteria but no separate spec versions.
comparison.reason: It tests diagnostic search and fuse extraction/reinsertion. The candidate instead tunes a mechanical response and explicitly does not extract its captive screw.
